title: execute
description: Run a command (task queue: Dağıtım, Uzak komut, scheduled tasks, PC actions). The server marks the task `Running` before it sends this and puts it back to `Pending` if the send fails. Only one task per device runs at a time. The agent answers with `result` (and `capability_denied` when the terminal capability or module is off). The same `task_id` may arrive again; an agent must not run a task twice at the same time.

script_path.description: The command line (the name is historical). The Windows agent runs it as a temporary .bat through cmd.exe as LocalSystem with a 30-minute limit.

requested_by.description: 0.1.12+. Panel user who queued it, or "System/Queue"; written to the device's local audit log.
